spec.causal_story: Gann High Low defines a transparent trend-state flip. Donchian confirmation requires price to break the stored channel extreme soon after the flip, filtering weak crosses. Positions exit on the opposite Gann state close or on an explicit ATR risk stop added for auditable portfolio sizing.

direct_translation: Gann High Low state from SMA(high, HPeriod) and SMA(low, LPeriod)
maximum bars allowed between Gann cross and Donchian confirmation
transparent_approximations: ATR initial stop is added because the Pine source had no hard stop and StrategyLab needs bounded risk for fixed-risk sizing.
Backtest fills use close plus configured slippage, matching the lab's bar-close research convention rather than claiming tick-perfect Pine equivalence.
